home.title: LIVRE — personalized name jewelry from Lebanon

lira.title: Your story, in a Livre
lira.text: Remember the 1 Livre coin? The golden 250 and the big silver 500? The cedar on one side, the value on the other. We turned the coins we grew up with into jewelry you can wear every day: a little piece of home, in silver or gold. New: the 250 and 500 Livres necklaces.

shopByStyle.title: Shop by Style
shopByStyle.subtitle: Find the piece that tells your story.

personalize.title: Personalize it
personalize.text: Choose your design and add the names, dates or words that mean the most to you.

craft.title: We craft it
craft.text: Each piece is made to order and checked by hand before it leaves us.

deliver.title: Delivered to you
deliver.text: Free delivery on your first order and on orders over $50, delivered in 2–7 days.

reviews.title: Loved by Customers
reviews.subtitle: Real notes from real LIVRE girls.

founder.quote: I wanted jewelry that feels like home: your name in metal, the cedar, the coin our grandparents kept. Every LIVRE piece is made for one person, and that is what makes it precious.
founder.name: Nour

handcrafted.title: Handcrafted with care
handcrafted.text: Cut, polished and checked by hand, one piece at a time.

personalized.title: Personalized for your story
personalized.text: Your name, your letter, your words, in the script you love.

quality.title: Quality materials
quality.text: Silver, gold and rose gold plating, and Double Gold Stainless Steel.

trusted.title: Trusted by Lebanese
trusted.text: Thousands of pieces delivered from Beirut to Akkar.

create.title: Create something personal
create.text: A name, an initial, a coin from home. Design it in a minute and see it before you buy.
